verdict.scope_summary: All three atomic requests landed: endpoint-scoped configuration feeds an allowance gate, over-limit deliveries wait in dedicated storage without consuming retries, and resumed retained deliveries route through the same gate. The largest in-scope effect is insertion of a complete endpoint-allowance stage between the queue and signed delivery. Most downstream movement is necessary accommodation for that inserted stage. The largest out-of-scope effect is the rigid 368-pixel rightward shift of the Status & operations section and its four children; it preserves prior meaning but creates five minor collateral-rework rows.
